description: An aerial flythrough of a hilly, forested coastal area in a real Minetest Game world (grass hills, stone cliffs, water, a small natural floating islet in the distance). A tree trunk stands on a grassy hillside with no canopy on top of it; a short flight further along the hillside reveals a free-floating clump of leaf cubes sitting apart from any trunk, with open sky visible in the gap between the trunk top and the floating leaves.
scenario: A real Minetest Game world (v7 mapgen, fixed seed 135797531), with default:leaves overridden to visual_scale=1.1 exactly as the reporter's second screenshot did. A trunk+canopy apple-tree-like structure is planted on dry land at x=80 (80 nodes from the world origin along +X), and the player is flown on a fixed scripted path (elevated flyover, no manual input) from over the bare trunk across to where the scaled canopy actually renders, ~8 nodes away.
